slippage_contract: max(0, entry_spread_pips - causal median of prior ten accepted event entry spreads) charged once at pip-value times lots
base_cost: raw mid-to-mid PnL minus observed executable PnL, plus USD4/lot commission, plus frozen dynamic slippage
note: The EA records every price and cost component; the post-run analyzer must independently recompute all arms. No observed result may alter this manifest.
